tagline.en: iOS developer building Flutter and Swift apps, and AI automation workflows.
tagline.id: iOS developer yang membangun aplikasi Flutter dan Swift, serta alur kerja otomasi AI.

bioShort.en: Bachelor of Informatics from Multi Data Palembang University (GPA 3.99/4.00), now a Junior iOS Developer at the Apple Developer Academy in Bali. Builds mobile applications with Flutter, Dart, and Swift, and previously shipped an attendance system used by staff at Indonesia's House of Representatives. Open to full-time mobile development roles.
bioShort.id: Sarjana Informatika Universitas Multi Data Palembang dengan IPK 3,99/4,00, kini Junior iOS Developer di Apple Developer Academy Bali. Membangun aplikasi mobile dengan Flutter, Dart, dan Swift, serta pernah mengembangkan sistem absensi yang dipakai staf Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Republik Indonesia. Terbuka untuk posisi full-time di pengembangan mobile.

bioLong.en:
Junior iOS Developer at the Apple Developer Academy in Bali, with a Bachelor of Informatics from Multi Data Palembang University (GPA 3.99/4.00). Works mainly in Flutter and Dart, and is now building depth in Swift.

As a mobile development intern at Indonesia's House of Representatives (DPR RI), led ABSATA, the attendance system its staff use. The undergraduate thesis, classifying Yogyakarta batik motifs at 98.36% accuracy, was published as first-author research in Sinkron (2026).

Alongside the engineering: assistant lecturer for three classes, a mathematics YouTube channel past 5,000 subscribers, and eight national and regional competition awards.
bioLong.id:
Junior iOS Developer di Apple Developer Academy Bali, lulusan Sarjana Informatika Universitas Multi Data Palembang (IPK 3,99/4,00). Terutama bekerja dengan Flutter dan Dart, dan kini memperdalam Swift.

Saat magang sebagai mobile developer di Dewan Perwakilan Rakyat Republik Indonesia (DPR RI), memimpin pengembangan ABSATA, sistem absensi yang dipakai stafnya. Skripsinya, klasifikasi motif batik Yogyakarta dengan akurasi 98,36%, terbit sebagai penulis pertama di Sinkron (2026).

Di samping pekerjaan teknis: asisten dosen untuk tiga kelas, kanal YouTube matematika dengan lebih dari 5.000 pelanggan, dan delapan penghargaan kompetisi tingkat nasional dan regional.
